result:
A copy issued this frame pushes its delay2 after the loop, so it isn't decremented until the next frame and is read only once that delay reaches 0 — never in the issuing frame.

Coincident expirations coalesce: the `copied=false` guard lets only the first zero-delay entry, in vector order, perform the authority and visual SSBO→CPU copies and the event. Every other delay hitting 0 in that same pass is simply dropped by the final retain — at most one readback per frame.

`OnTerrainChange` is emitted unconditionally alongside the copy, not gated on whether pixel values actually changed, so identical contents still fire it.
